notes.title: Update 3 - New Vehicle Physics + Harbor Location
notes.content:
[p]We’ve just released [b]Update 3[/b] for [i]Oil Refinery: The Simulation[/i], bringing two major additions to the game:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577171/5169600bb12ef292cab7fe8f2c36f4d9f3cae9f0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]🚛 [b]New Vehicle with Improved Physics[/b]
A new, smaller transport vehicle has been added, featuring completely reworked driving physics for smoother and more predictable handling. Existing vehicles still use the original system - this allows you to compare both and let us know which version you prefer. Your feedback will help shape the future of all vehicle handling in the game.[/p][p][/p][p]⚓ [b]New Harbor Location[/b]
We've expanded the game world with a brand-new Harbor area! Some delivery destinations have been relocated there to integrate this new location into your workflow. Expect the Harbor to become even more important in future updates.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45577171/38752ad65c23a3aa641e2ab43f9c8765809d582b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]💰 [b]Looking Ahead: Update 4 – Market Forces[/b]
Next up, we’ll be focusing on the economy system. Update 4 will introduce dynamic pricing and more player choice, making locations like the Harbor play a bigger strategic role.[/p][p][/p][p]⚠️ [b]Known Issue[/b]
The new vehicle may display a visual glitch with the rear wheels on some systems. This does not affect gameplay and does not occur universally, but we are aware of the issue and working on a fix.
[/p][p]
Thank you for your continued support, and stay tuned for the upcoming update![/p]

notes.title: Update 1.2.0 – New Tutorial Available Now!
notes.content:
We’ve just released Update 1.2.0, featuring a brand-new tutorial for Oil Refinery – The Simulation! The tutorial now starts automatically the next time you launch the game and must be completed once. After that, you can replay it anytime from the main menu.

This update is based entirely on your feedback - thank you!
Now we want to hear more:
[list]
[*]How do you like the new tutorial?
[*]What would you like to see added or improved in the next update?
[/list]

Let us know in the comments!
